name: Bosch EDC16U34

sources: own reference stock/tuned reads of SW 1037382088 and sibling P447 software (not committed): maps diff-derived - see docs/MAP-LIBRARY.md
EDC16 checksum: docs/BOSCH-CHECKSUM.md, cross-checked with LeZed97/ZedSuite (GPL-3.0, run unmodified, no code taken)

notes: VAG 1.9 TDI PD. Diagnostics over CAN (ISO 15765-4); some vehicles answer KWP2000, others UDS - set diag_layer to match the car. flash_size is the 2 MiB (2097152-byte) full-flash read the maps below are offsets into; the EDC16 processor flash itself is 512 KiB but the maps were diff-derived against the 2 MiB fixture read. Addresses are placeholders for the family and must be confirmed per software variant before any read or write.

maps.name: injection quantity limiter (smoke / air-mass limiter)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: HIGH. Source: DIFF-DERIVED from a Golf 1.9 TDI PD stock.bin vs a third-party 'squeeze' tune (tuned_uncorrected.bin) plus the in-image map header, cross-checked against the EDC16 standard 0.01 mg/stroke IQ LSB. This is the Mengenbegrenzung ueber Luftmasse (injected-quantity limit vs engine speed and air mass); the tune raised these cells to release fuel. Addresses are byte offsets into the 2 MiB full-flash read (matches the fixtures). The in-flash header at 0x1D307E encodes rows=16, cols=13 followed by the two axis tables. Stock decodes to 13.9..59.1 mg/stroke (full-load smoke limit ~59 mg, tapering at high rpm) with both axes strictly monotonic. Confirm per software variant before any write.

maps.name: torque limiter (vs engine speed and atmospheric pressure)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: HIGH on location/shape, MEDIUM-HIGH on the physical unit. Source: DIFF-DERIVED (one of the two regions the reference tune changed, +5..11% on every active cell) plus the in-image header at 0x1D16F6 (rows=4, cols=20, Y[4] at 0x1D16FA, rpm X[20] at 0x1D1702, data at 0x1D172A). Earlier releases placed this map 4 bytes late (0x1D172E), which shifted every row by two cells; the 0/550/551 rpm breakpoints and the 0 at 5100 rpm only line up at 0x1D172A. Y axis 600/700/890/930 = atmospheric pressure in hPa (altitude derate). Unit: EDC16 PD uses a torque-based structure - this limiter feeds the torque-to-injection-quantity conversion map, whose torque axis spans 0..336 Nm; read as 0.1 Nm/LSB the stock limit peaks at 316 Nm and converts to ~56 mg/stroke at 3000 rpm, just under the 59 mg smoke limit, while a 0.01 mg/stroke reading (31.6 mg) would make the engine unable to reach its smoke limit. Stock decodes 0..316 Nm. Byte offsets into the 2 MiB full-flash read of SW 1037382088 (P447); addresses move between software variants - locate the same header (dims + axis breakpoints) in your own read and confirm before any write.

maps.name: driver's wish (pedal map) 1 of 8
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH. Source: in-image header at 0x1C2370 (rows=16 rpm 0..5355, cols=8 accelerator pedal 1..100 % at 0.01 %/LSB) - one of a block of 7 same-axis 16x8 tables at 0x1C2370..0x1C2CA8 plus an 8th at 0x1C2CCA with an rpm axis to 6000. Not changed by the reference tune (a fuel/torque-limit tune). Cross-checked on two further P447 software variants (SW 1037381814 and 1037389289; reference stock/tuned read pairs): there a tune changed the table with the identical header dimensions and axis breakpoints, which pins down its role. Those tunes raised the part-to-full-pedal columns of every member. Unit: requested torque, 0.1 Nm/LSB signed (member 7 holds -2.0 Nm drag-torque cells, impossible for a fuel quantity; stock full-pedal requests 219..429 Nm, consistent with the torque limiter and the torque-to-IQ conversion axis). Which member is active depends on gear/mode selection that is not decoded; tuners edit all of them consistently. Byte offsets into the 2 MiB full-flash read of SW 1037382088 (P447); addresses move between software variants - locate the same header (dims + axis breakpoints) in your own read and confirm before any write.

maps.name: torque to injection quantity conversion
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH. Source: in-image header at 0x1D3FA0 (rows=15 rpm 1000..5000, cols=16 torque 0..336 Nm at 0.1 Nm/LSB, data 0..72.4 mg/stroke at 0.01 mg/LSB). Cross-checked on two further P447 software variants (SW 1037381814 and 1037389289; reference stock/tuned read pairs): there a tune changed the table with the identical header dimensions and axis breakpoints, which pins down its role. Those tunes raised the high-torque columns (more fuel per Nm). The near-linear rows (0 Nm -> 0 mg, ~0.19 mg per Nm) are the textbook torque-to-fuel conversion shape. Not changed by the reference tune. Byte offsets into the 2 MiB full-flash read of SW 1037382088 (P447); addresses move between software variants - locate the same header (dims + axis breakpoints) in your own read and confirm before any write.

maps.name: boost pressure target 1 of 2
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH. Source: in-image header at 0x1E470C (rows=16 rpm 0..4746, cols=10 injection quantity 0..45 mg/stroke at 0.01 mg/LSB, data absolute charge pressure in hPa/mbar). Cross-checked on two further P447 software variants (SW 1037381814 and 1037389289; reference stock/tuned read pairs): there a tune changed the table with the identical header dimensions and axis breakpoints, which pins down its role. maps.name: boost pressure limiter (vs atmospheric pressure)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH. Source: in-image header at 0x1E49FC (rows=11 rpm 1490..4494, cols=10 atmospheric pressure 626..1007 hPa, data absolute charge-pressure ceiling in hPa). Cross-checked on two further P447 software variants (SW 1037381814 and 1037389289; reference stock/tuned read pairs): there a tune changed the table with the identical header dimensions and axis breakpoints, which pins down its role. Those tunes raised the cells above ~700 hPa ambient. Stock decodes 1109..2225 hPa, falling with altitude and at high rpm (turbo overspeed protection). Not changed by the reference tune. Byte offsets into the 2 MiB full-flash read of SW 1037382088 (P447); addresses move between software variants - locate the same header (dims + axis breakpoints) in your own read and confirm before any write.

maps.name: injection duration (PD crank-angle) 1 of 4
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH on location/role, LOW on the angle scaling (left RAW). Source: in-image header at 0x1DF162 (rows=19 rpm, cols=15 injection quantity 0.5..60 mg/stroke at 0.01 mg/LSB, signed cells). Cross-checked on two further P447 software variants (SW 1037381814 and 1037389289; reference stock/tuned read pairs): there a tune changed the table with the identical header dimensions and axis breakpoints, which pins down its role. Those tunes raised the >=20 mg columns of all four tables in step with their fuel increase. The cells grow ~8x from 0.5 to 60 mg at every rpm and go negative only at minimal quantity/high rpm (no injection) - the shape of a quantity-to-duration (solenoid valve closing angle) map rather than start-of-injection. Cells are shipped as RAW signed counts: the crank-angle LSB is not confirmed for this software (Bosch commonly uses 3/128 deg = 0.0234375 deg/LSB; verify before reading absolute degrees). Edit by ratio, not absolute angle. Byte offsets into the 2 MiB full-flash read of SW 1037382088 (P447); addresses move between software variants - locate the same header (dims + axis breakpoints) in your own read and confirm before any write.
